Would you like me to help you draft a message or email about it? If so, just let me know:

- What's affected (service, system, region, etc.)
- When it started / current status
- Any ETA for resolution or workarounds
- Who should receive it (email addresses or team name)

Once I have those details, I can put together a clear update and send it out whenever you're ready.
